active.reason: Requests distinguish identity span extraction, described fields, structured/relational or multilingual evidence, category mapping and semantic action choice. Exact-control path bypasses inference. Dispatch tests cover every requested family plus hybrid evidence steps; no universal model or implicit version ladder.

retained_regressions.reason: Morgan/Taylor inventory replay uses explicit caller owner/count schema. Both Morgan rows satisfy identity, 7 sorts before 12, and Taylor 2 is excluded. Extraction provider returns grounded fields; the reducer picks second. Renaming/order and reversed ranking tests preserve caller semantics. Whole-action classification and fixture constants are absent from the engine.

inherited_boundary_review.reason: Test cases preserve same-record evidence and exact operation; unknown or conflicting possible competitors and ties defer; known mismatches can be excluded; nonexistent class/action IDs, wrong source offsets, disabled and stale actions are rejected. Typed duration rejects clock time. These checks follow the current sketch, not a new policy invented from tests.
